title: Israeli military reportedly warns Netanyahu an Iran strike could ignite multiple regional fronts
detail: Per a Google News aggregation, the Israeli military has warned Prime Minister Netanyahu that a strike on Iran could ignite multiple regional fronts. Details are as aggregated; not independently verified here.

title: Trump reportedly considers Iran strikes after the new year while Israel pushes for earlier action
detail: Per a Google News aggregation, Trump is reportedly considering strikes on Iran after the new year, while Israel pushes for earlier action. Details are as aggregated; not independently verified here.
